outcome: Passed on retry after the ground-truth checks were added (attempt 1 hit an over-broad trap, since narrowed). Reviewed by the product owner: all five bullets true. Bullet 1 reworded for clarity before publishing.

bullets.text: Merged PRs spent a median 7.3 days in the stage from ready for review to merged, while the slowest 10% took over 64 days.
For merged PRs, reaching a reviewer lgtm took a median 4.1 days and the slowest 10% took over 49 days; once both review labels were set the median merge time was 1.7 hours.
Across the repo, 272 open PRs remain without any human response and have a median wait of 41 days in that queue.
There are 368 open PRs waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm with a median wait of 69 days, and 231 of those 368 (63%) are labeled for sig/api-machinery or sig/node.
By team queue, sig/api-machinery has 120 PRs waiting for a reviewer’s lgtm with a median wait of 85 days, making it the largest by total waiting in that stage.
